content:
Maria Chen: FYI — getting multiple customer alerts about 504/timeouts from hosted inference in us-east, started ~23:12 UTC. Support ticket from AcmeRetail high priority.
ops-bot: created incident INC-7890 and paged oncall.
Samir Patel: I'm looking at gateway traces now. Primer: this looks like requests hitting the runtime and hanging, not immediate 5xx from auth.
Kevin Liu: I'm seeing a spike in `apigw_inflight` and NLB connection resets around the same time. Backend reports long tail of token fetches.
Julie Park: Acme says checkout failing, they're rate-limited by retries from frontend. Need quick mitigations and customer comms.
Tom O'Neil: Can someone paste a minimal repro? I want to reproduce locally against staging.
Maria Chen: Repro curl: `curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\",\"max_tokens\":200}'` — hangs ~15s then 504.
Samir Patel: Pasted relevant logs: ```
2026-03-17T23:12:21Z apigw request_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate lat_ms=15102 status=504
2026-03-17T23:12:21Z runtime node=redwood-worker-14 request_id=abc123 state=kvcache-stall wait_ms=14800
2026-03-17T23:12:22Z auth-proxy token_fetch id=xyz err=timeout
```
Kevin Liu: Token fetch timeouts look real — auth-proxy reported a small client-side spike. But even with token present we see KV cache miss amplification. Two failure modes colliding.
Julie Park: Immediate mitigations?
Samir Patel: 1) Enable fallback model variant (smaller FP16) for affected route (instant config flip). 2) Increase apigw circuit-breaker threshold and extend timeout to avoid prematurely returning 504s during KV stall. 3) Throttle incoming burst from selected customer to reduce pressure.
Tom O'Neil: I'll flip fallback now and scale the worker pool +2. Doing config change: `redwoodctl routes set-route --name /v1/generate --fallback smallgen-v1`
Maria Chen: Done. Notifying Acme support with ETA ~10m.
ops-bot: config-change applied by Tom O'Neil at 2026-03-17T23:18:03Z. New worker replicas: +2.
Samir Patel: After fallback + scale we're seeing request success improve from 60%->95% in the last 3m. Latency p95 still elevated but no customer-visible failures.
Kevin Liu: Root causes to investigate: a recent auth-proxy concurrency regression + KV cache warmup failure causing long tail. Need clear repro and timeline.
Julie Park: Action items (assignments):
- Samir: capture full request traces and correlate request IDs to auth-proxy logs (due 2026-03-18 12:00 UTC)
- Kevin: dig into kvcache warmup heuristics and reproduce OOM/miss pattern on staging (due 2026-03-19 18:00 UTC)
- Tom: document the fallback flip play and add a one-click rollback in console (due 2026-03-24)
- Maria: customer comms draft and account handoff to CSE (due 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC)
- Julie: update runbook to include combined auth+cache surge pattern and add an alert for auth-fetch p99 > 2s (due 2026-03-22)
Samir Patel: Also proposing a short-term mitigation: add a soft headroom token cache in apigw to reduce token_fetch spikes. I'll prototype on staging.
Kevin Liu: Noted. I'll run a targeted load test to reproduce KV miss amplification with token latency. Please coordinate windows.
Maria Chen: Final note — we've scheduled an incident follow-up meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC to firm up postmortem and customer-facing timeline. If anyone has extra telemetry they want included (eg. NLB logs, docker restart counts), drop them in this thread.
support-bot: Incident INC-7890 status -> mitigated. Next update scheduled 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z.
Tom O'Neil: Thanks team — closing hands-on mitigation. Will update PRs and console docs later today.
Maria Chen: Thanks all, we'll convert this to a postmortem doc after the 09:00 follow-up and include action item owners above.
